sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: At Angelika Fashions, we collect personal information necessary to deliver exceptional craftsmanship and service. This includes your name, shipping address, billing address, phone number, email address, and order history.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your data solely to fulfill orders, process payments securely, provide order tracking updates via SMS or WhatsApp, and improve your shopping experience. We never sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Payment Security
sections.content: All payment transactions are encrypted using 256-bit SSL encryption and processed through trusted PCI-DSS certified payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe). We do not store complete credit card or debit card numbers on our servers.

sections.title: 4. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us at support@angelikafashions.com.

sections.title: 1. General Overview
sections.content: Welcome to Angelika Fashions. By visiting our site and/or purchasing handcrafted garments from us, you engage in our service and agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions.

sections.title: 2. Products and Handcrafted Variations
sections.content: Our collections are handcrafted by skilled artisans. As each piece involves hand-block printing, hand-embroidery, and traditional weaving techniques, subtle variations in color, texture, and motif placement are intrinsic to authentic artisan craftsmanship and are not considered defects.

sections.title: 3. Pricing and Orders
sections.content: All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (₹) inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. We reserve the right to modify prices or discontinue items without prior notice.

sections.title: 4. Support & Questions
sections.content: For any questions regarding these terms, please visit our Contact Page or reach out to us at Customer Support FAQ.

seo.metaDescription: Terms of service and conditions of use for handcrafted Indian luxury wear at Angelika Fashions.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small encrypted text files stored on your browser or device when you explore the Angelika Fashions digital atelier. They allow our website to recognize your preferences, remember your bag and wishlist selections, and deliver a tailored luxury shopping experience.

sections.title: 2. Categories of Cookies We Employ
sections.content:
• Essential Atelier Cookies: Vital for core functions such as shopping bag persistence, secure user authentication, and checkout flow.
• Preference & Craft Cookies: Remember your selected size recommendations, currency settings, and recently viewed heirloom designs.
• Analytical Performance Cookies: Help us anonymously evaluate how clients interact with collections and discover ways to optimize navigation speed.

sections.title: 3. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
sections.content: You have complete autonomy over your cookie preferences. You can adjust your browser settings to decline or clear cookies at any time. Please note that disabling essential cookies may impact certain concierge and checkout features on our atelier platform.

sections.title: 4. Concierge Enquiries
sections.content: For further questions regarding our cookie protocols or data protection practices, please connect with our concierge team at concierge@angelikafashions.com.

seo.metaDescription: Understand how Angelika Fashions utilizes cookies to provide an elevated browsing and bespoke shopping experience.

sections.title: Our Dedication to Inclusivity
sections.content: At Angelika Fashions, we believe true luxury is welcoming and universally accessible. We are passionately committed to ensuring our digital atelier conforms to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA benchmarks, delivering a seamless experience for visitors of all abilities.

sections.title: Key Accessibility Initiatives
sections.content:
• Clear Contrast & Typography: Carefully chosen color contrast ratios and legible type scales to ease readability across all devices.
• Full Keyboard Navigation: All interactive elements, navigation dropdowns, modals, and checkout steps are fully operable via keyboard.
• Assistive Technology Support: Comprehensive ARIA labels, semantic landmark regions, and descriptive alt attributes for screen readers.
• Reduced Motion Accommodations: Respect for user system preferences regarding reduced animations and motion effects.

brand-story.title: Artisanal Luxury, Rooted in Indian Heritage
brand-story.story: Every piece in the Angelika collection is thoughtfully curated by designer Vidhya, honoring ancient weaving traditions while embracing contemporary silhouettes.
brand-story.quote: "Fashion that honors where you come from while embracing where you are going."
storyParagraphs: Angelika Fashions was born from Vidhya's passion for preserving Indian textile heritage while creating contemporary silhouettes for the modern woman.
Every piece in our collection is thoughtfully designed, from selecting the finest fabrics to collaborating with skilled artisans who bring generations of expertise to each stitch.
When you wear Angelika, you're not just wearing clothes — you're wearing a piece of tradition reimagined for today, made with integrity and worn with confidence.
